title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This version keeps the curated reader-facing working surface and adds a compact Paper 02 ν/v source-audit correction package after the RA25-RA27 symbol-audit tranches.

Current reader files. The main cumulative readers and standalone English paper PDFs remain the reader-facing surface. RA25, RA26, RA27, and the RA28 ν/v package are correction/audit tranches for the German/source branch of Paper 02, not full multilingual propagation packages.

Latest correction package. `nu_inversion_revert_for_RA28_20260612.zip` documents a source-based adjudication of Noether Paper 02 glyphs previously at risk of being propagated as Latin v. It restores the Greek ν form-letter reading in the RA27 German cumulative, includes high-resolution evidence crops, a line-anchored revert ledger, a unified diff, recursive-scan disposition CSV, and restored German TeX/PDF. It also records protected genuine Latin v cases.

Status at a glance. This is not a certified critical edition. The files are useful working drafts, translation drafts, and source-audit correction packets; subtle formula errors, scan-reading errors, apparatus drift, and cross-language synchronization errors may remain. Verify important equations, tables, theorem statements, and unusual notation against the source witnesses before citation-critical use.

Known open items. The ν/v correction has not yet been propagated through English, Spanish, Japanese, French, or Chinese branches. Paper 02 section 25 starting at p83 bottom / p84 onward, pp84-90, and table plates remain open. Full symbol-level source audit remains open beyond Paper 01 and the current Paper 02 tranches.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
